_Auto-actualisation_: le plugin enverra: _Auto-update_: The plugin will send all selected measurements according to the chosen schedule in a single call; by default, this occurs every minute.

_Temps réel_: le plugin enverra les mesu: _Real-time_: The plugin will send measurements one by one each time a value changes, potentially resulting in several calls per second for the same command (depending on your equipment and commands).
